meta.question: Which champions convert 7.3 Statikk Shiv's on-hit bounce? Top 5.

ranking.name: Varus
ranking.notes: W on-hit + Blight stacks bounce, then one Q detonates the clump. Innate turns AS into AD+AP.

ranking.name: Kog'Maw
ranking.notes: W Bio-Arcane is %max HP on-hit for 8s. Bounce copies W onto the whole pit.

ranking.name: Kalista
ranking.notes: Rend spears bounce; one E rips the whole clump. 40 AP is mostly wasted.

ranking.name: Teemo
ranking.notes: Toxic Shot on-hit + 4s poison bounce. 40 AP is fully spent. Nashor core.

ranking.name: Twitch
ranking.notes: Venom stacks bounce, then E (7.3 hybrid). Spray and Pray already applies on-hit in a line — overlap.

ranking.name: Kayle
ranking.notes: E on-hit + 40/40/30% is her dream stat line. Aflame waves already splash E after 9, so kit overlap.

ranking.name: Kai'Sa
ranking.notes: Plasma on-hit bounces (7.3 AP ratios). Secondaries rarely reach a 5-stack pop from Shiv alone.

ranking.name: Ashe
ranking.notes: Frost Shot slow bounces — utility, almost no extra damage. 7.3 Frost bonus is crit-scaled.

ranking.name: Vayne
ranking.notes: Silver Bolts do not apply to extra targets (same as Runaan's) and expire on switch. AP wasted.
